# Correct omitted 9 and 3 pixels in input rows 18 and 19 (0-based).
G[18][3]=9; G[18][5]=9; G[18][14]=3; G[18][15]=3; G[18][16]=3; G[18][17]=2
G[19][3]=9; G[19][5]=9
# Group bounding boxes and translations
regions={'7':(range(3,7),range(2,7),(2,-1)),
         '8':(range(1,4),range(16,21),(14,-7)),
         '4':(range(7,12),range(9,13),(0,0)),
         '3':(range(13,19),range(13,20),(-9,-8)),
         '9':(range(17,22),range(2,7),(-6,7))}
# Translate pixels in regions, combine, track any overlaps
out=[[0]*22 for _ in range(22)]; owners={}
for name,(rs,cs,(dr,dc)) in regions.items():
    for r in rs:
        for c in cs:
            v=G[r][c]
            if not v: continue
            rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
            assert 0<=rr<22 and 0<=cc<22,(name,r,c,rr,cc)
            prev=out[rr][cc]
            if prev and prev != v: print('collision',name,(rr,cc),prev,v)
            if prev and prev==v: print('overlap same',name,(rr,cc),v)
            out[rr][cc]=v
            owners.setdefault((rr,cc),[]).append(name)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out))
print('nonzero counts', {name:sum(G[r][c]!=0 for r in rs for c in cs) for name,(rs,cs,_) in regions.items()})
